findings.claim: Unqualified identification of time to singleton with the positive multipermutation level in BCJO v2, over a carrier including singleton states.
findings.evidence: BCJO v2 §2 lines 95–96 use a smallest positive integer. At a singleton the t>=0 hitting time is 0 and that level is 1.
findings.accepted_qualification: Equality only for initial cardinality greater than 1 which actually reaches a singleton, or after a separately explicit zero-inclusive convention.
findings.effect: No change to cardinal descent, eight-point irretractability, source ownership or zero-nomination decision. No author repair and no blanket all-claims PASS.
